verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents official SDKs across many platforms. These include rollbar.js for server-side and client-side JavaScript, a .NET SDK with Blazor support and an LTS release track, a Ruby gem and Apple modules, and the product flags out-of-date SDKs in its UI. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality, evidence of an official client SDK for the read/management REST API (the documented SDKs are error-reporting notifiers)

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: It is used by our official SDKs to report errors/exceptions, deploys, and other mes
Cross platform: Rollbar.js supports both server-side and client-side Javascript, including frameworks such as React, Angular, Express, Next.js and more.
The primary motivation for making another major version of the SDK is the addition of Blazor Client-Side support.
When viewing an item in the Item Detail Page you will see a notification if your SDK is out of date.
